guard: the sealed host scan is owner-filtered, key/body-bound, and unconditionally cleaned, while the minted remote executor holds no records consumer lifecycle authority
why: The native scanner fixture writes a valid own row, valid and malformed foreign-owner rows, then runs the production sealed scanner over a real authenticated broker.
M1 removes authenticated-owner filtering, so the malformed foreign row reaches the scan and the own-row success assertion never completes.
M2 removes key/body binding, so the deliberately mismatched own row is accepted instead of failing on the named qualifier assertion.
M3 restores the shipped wildcard records consumer lifecycle to the executor; the real minted-credential probe observes enumeration, push export, and foreign deletion instead of three denials.
M4 removes the host scanner's unconditional final delete; the real broker retains the literal consumer and the named cleanup assertion fails.

mutations.name: M1 remove authenticated-owner filter from the broker consumer
mutations.expectRed: own scan succeeds despite valid and malformed foreign owners
mutations.cell: own scan succeeds despite valid and malformed foreign owners
mutations.note: The malformed foreign row becomes deliverable and makes the scan fail before it can return the valid own row.

mutations.name: M2 remove exact key/body qualifier binding
mutations.note: The mismatched own row is accepted, so the fixture's named rejection assertion fails.

mutations.name: M3 reintroduce wildcard records consumer lifecycle on the remote executor
mutations.expectRed: all three participant records-consumer powers are absent
mutations.cell: all three participant records-consumer powers are absent
mutations.note: The real typed minted executor regains the measured sweep, push exporter, and foreign delete powers, so the final absence assertion prints FAIL.

mutations.name: M4 remove unconditional final deletion of the host scan consumer
mutations.find: try { await jsm.consumers.delete(stream, MANAGER_GOAL_INDEX_SCANNER_CONSUMER_NAME); } catch { /* bounded inactivity is the orphan backstop */ }
mutations.replace: if (false) try { await jsm.consumers.delete(stream, MANAGER_GOAL_INDEX_SCANNER_CONSUMER_NAME); } catch { /* bounded inactivity is the orphan backstop */ }
mutations.expectRed: host scan consumer is cleaned after the scan
mutations.cell: host scan consumer is cleaned after the scan
mutations.note: The first successful native scan leaves the literal consumer behind, and the fixture's independent INFO check observes it.
